chunks: As for whatever is in it from Isḥāq ibn Burayd, I have transmitted it from Muḥammad ibn Mūsā ibn al-Mutawakkil—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn al-Saʿdābādī, from Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbd Allāh al-Barqī, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr al-Bazantī, from al-Muthannā ibn al-Walīd, from Isḥāq ibn Burayd.
ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Isḥāq ibn Burayd in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage is a sanad/isnad clarification in which the author specifies his transmission path to narrations coming from Isḥāq ibn Burayd. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of narrators for hadith transmission within Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh.
